scope: Single fixed conditional quote diagnostic for resource triage; no investable portfolio backtest or prospective signal
hypothesis: Issuer repurchase announcements may contain information or potential subsequent demand whose response continues after the first next-date market open. Announced plans are discretionary, not guaranteed execution.
cohort: All 47 2024 board-resolution cases from the source census; use earliest retained non-revision board record for each exact issuer/board date. No outcome, realization, quantity, price-range or execution-rate filter. Purpose changes and completion/threshold messages are not new entries.
source_gate: All 122 source identities including one explicitly recovered HTTP502, exact 12-month/full-year agreement, all47 cases linked with no missing earliest record or ambiguity, independent source audit passed. A separate activation receipt pins the final source checkpoint before any price calculation.
publication_assumption: Use verified current official pages reported Asia/Taipei publication timestamps. Full current-vintage coverage and retained corrections do not prove contemporaneous first availability, absence of withdrawn records, or 2024 storage immutability. These remain explicit assumptions, not repaired by latency.
entry: First full-market session strictly after the Taipei publication calendar date, at reference-adjusted opening quote. Even pre-open publication waits until the next market date. No shift to a later quoted date if missing.
exit: Close of twentieth full-market session including entry. Market calendar includes halts; missing endpoints remain gaps, no zero fills or replacement case.
benchmark: 0050 over exactly the same entry/exit dates, same quote adjustment basis and hypothetical costs; not a physical cash/dividend ledger or actual broker fee schedule.
parameter_source: Costs and20-session quote machinery reuse the already-declared index-review diagnostic conventions, not the failed index strategy or its events. No cost/period selection based on new outcomes.
resource_gate: Coverage all47complete; at primary0.005cost at least3of4 publication-quarter mean relative quote changes>0 and pooled event median relative>0. Fourquarters must all have events. No alternate side/horizon/year if failed.
sample_limitations: 2024 price years already used in other project research; this is not a new independent holdout
47 cases include repeated issuers and overlapping windows; quarterly/issuer summaries are descriptive, not independent-trial significance or causal alpha
Reference-adjusted price ratios do not equal shareholder cash returns; zero/current-vintage timestamp assumptions and opening-limit/lot fills are unverified
No300000TWD portfolio, capital allocation, T+2 overlap, taxes/minimum commissions, actual fills or reinvestment modeled
on_fail: Stop this fixed announcement-continuation hypothesis without tuning or expanding years. Retain all source tools and failed diagnostic.
on_pass: Only justify a separately frozen independent-evidence/implementation proposal; no daily human validation or trades.
